> Complete AI reference document covering schemas, ingestion pipelines, matching methodology, and legal compliance.

## Technical Architecture & Ingestion Engine
Opportunity OS runs automated periodic ingestion sweeps across 50+ career networks and developer platforms:
1. **Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)**:
   - Greenhouse (`/api/ingest/connectors/greenhouse`)
   - Lever (`/api/ingest/connectors/lever`)
   - Ashby (`/api/ingest/connectors/ashby`)
2. **Startup & Community Portals**:
   - Y Combinator Work at a Startup
   - Hacker News ("Who is Hiring?" monthly threads)
   - Devpost Hackathons & Bounties
   - Unstop Case Competitions & Scholarships
   - Curated Open Source Career Repositories

### Opportunity Entity Schema
```typescript
interface Opportunity {
  id: string; // UUID primary key
  title: string;
  organization: string;
  category: "internship" | "fulltime" | "case_competition" | "hackathon" | "fellowship" | "scholarship" | "conference" | "workshop" | "bootcamp" | "networking" | "campus_ambassador" | "remote_gig" | "freebie" | "certification" | "other";
  description: string | null;
  summary: string | null;
  tags: string[];
  required_skills: string[]; // AI-extracted lowercase skills for gap analysis
  deadline: string | null; // ISO 8601 string
  eligibility: string | null;
  location: string | null;
  compensation: string | null;
  is_remote: boolean;
  apply_url: string | null;
  difficulty: "low" | "medium" | "high" | null;
  estimated_value_score: number | null; // 0..100
  status: "active" | "expired" | "spam" | "pending";
}
```

---

## 0–100 Resume Scoring & AI Fallover Architecture
The platform matches candidate profiles to listings via a two-stage evaluation pipeline:
1. **Deterministic Skill Vector Matching**: Compares extracted resume skills against `required_skills` using Jaccard index and set intersection.
2. **LLM Deep Evaluation**:
   - Primary: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash (`gemini-2.0-flash`) via `@google/generative-ai`.
   - Secondary Fallover: Groq Llama 3.1 8B / 3.3 70B (`llama-3.1-8b-instant`) via `groq-sdk`.
   - Strict Zod schema enforcement on structured JSON responses.

### Scoring Breakdown Rubric (0–100 Scale)
- **Profile Relevance (35%)**: Direct alignment of candidate skills, tools, and past projects.
- **Career & Brand Upside (25%)**: Company reputation, funding stage, mentorship quality, and tier prestige.
- **Compensation & Equity (15%)**: Market-competitive salary, stipend, or prize pool value.
- **Skill Accessibility & Ease (15%)**: Feasibility of candidate clearing technical interview benchmarks.
- **Urgency (10%)**: Proximity to closing deadline.

---

## Statutory & Regulatory Compliance
- **Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA 2023)**: Full compliance with Section 5/6 (Notice & Consent), Section 9 (Protection of Minors), Section 11 (Right to Data Portability via JSON export), Section 12 (Right to Erasure), and Section 13 (Grievance Redressal Officer: Krishna Gahlod, 30-day statutory TAT).
- **Payment Compliance**: Dodo Payments PCI-DSS Tier 1 Merchant of Record integration with server-side signature validation, anti-replay guards, and 7-day refund policy.
- **Security Headers**: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin.
